text:
sam: Heads-up — after kernel-selector v3 rolled to canary we see a sharp drop in KV/prefix hit-rate on several long-prefix routes. Latency tail creeping up. Not blocking rollout yet but we need a short mitigation plan.

deploy-bot: Deployed kernel-selector v3 to canary at 2026-03-16T09:12Z :rocket:

olivia: I pulled traces and metrics. Example: /generate-longprefix route hit-rate went from 72% -> 41% in canary. p50 +45ms, p95 +120ms. Snapshot: 
```
route: /generate-longprefix
kv.prefix.hitrate: 0.41 (canary)
kv.prefix.hitrate: 0.72 (prod baseline)
sample_keys: ["user:123:ctx:hello", "user:123:ctx:hello world", "user:124:ctx:hello"]
```

jordan: Quick hypothesis: kernel v3 changed batching shapes & we now run an extra preprocessing normalization step that trims trailing whitespace in the prompt when choosing cache keys. That means previously cached keys (with trailing spaces) no longer match. I can reproduce locally by toggling `normalize_prompt_whitespace` in the runtime.

alice: Oof. Two orthogonal levers: 1) compatibility shim to accept both normalized and legacy keys (cheap in runtime), 2) seeding job to re-populate canonical keys for canary/staging so cold misses are reduced during rollout. I can stand up the seeder job.

sam: Prefer shim + seeder over revert. Revert is noisy and pauses rollout. Next: narrow plan of action?

jordan: Plan suggestion:
- short-term runtime change: enable `legacy_key_accept=true` in kernel v3 path (hotfix)
- seeder: targeted seed of top-1k prefixes for affected routes for canary + staging for next 30m
- autoscale hook: when new replica joins, fire lightweight synthetic traffic for hot prefixes (to avoid cold starts)
- metrics: add rapid alert if kv.prefix.hitrate < 0.6 for any critical route

olivia: I will add a heatmap to console: `kv.prefix.hitrate` per route + a nightly diff. Also pushing a small dashboard for canary vs prod.

alice: Seeder details (wip):
```
# kubernetes CronJob (canary limited)
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: prefix-seeder-canary
spec:
  schedule: "*/5 * * * *"  # run every 5m for 30m rollout window
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          containers:
          - name: seeder
            image: redwood/prefix-seeder:stable
            args: ["--route","/generate-longprefix","--limit","1000","--mode","light"]
```
curl example to trigger a single-item seed: `curl -X POST https://canary.internal/seed -d '{"prefix":"user:123:ctx:hello"}'`

sam: For autoscale hook, we already have `node-init` webhooks. Suggest patching it to call `/internal/seed?mode=bootstrap&limit=50`. Who owns that patch?

alice: I can own the cronjob + the small autoscale call (5m turnaround).

jordan: I'll cut the runtime shim patch and a test. It's a small conditional: accept legacy key variants for 48 hours then flip off once seeder finishes. I'll add a flag `compat_keys_ttl=48h`.

infra-bot: Created job `seeder-canary-190123` (job-id: seeder-190123) targeting canary cluster with limit=1000. Scheduled to run now.

olivia: Added temporary alert rule: `kv.prefix.hitrate < 0.6` for routes in {"/generate-longprefix","/chat-stream"} to the canary channel.

jordan: Also FYI — kernel v3 changes batching heuristics: it merges short heads more aggressively which reduced the number of KV lookups in some cases but flipped key normalization order for a small subset. I pushed a profiling flamegraph here: https://profiler.redwood.internal/fg/190123 (contains before/after). Look at the `kv_lookup` path.

sam: OK owners: sam (coord), olivia (metrics & dashboard), jordan (runtime shim + tests), alice (seeder + autoscale hook). Runbook:
- T+0: enable `legacy_key_accept=true` in canary runtime (jordan)
- T+5: seeder job runs (alice/infra-bot)
- T+10: monitor heatmap; if hit-rate > 0.65, continue rollout.
- T+30: disable compat flag if seeder warmed prefixes and metrics stable.

olivia: I'll post a short report in #eng-runtime after first seeder run with canary vs prod deltas.

sam: Thanks — we'll avoid a full revert unless heatmap worsens. Ping me if anything spikes. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary cluster scaled +2 nodes at 2026-03-16T09:18Z (triggered by traffic).

alice: Seeder ran — quick summary: 980/1000 prefixes seeded, observed canary kv.prefix.hitrate jump to 0.62 after first run. Continuing two more iterations.

jordan: Pushed shim PR: `runtime: accept legacy keys (compat mode)` — link: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/834 (tests green locally).

sam: Great. Keep thread updates concise. If hit-rate stays <0.6 after 3 rounds we discuss temporary revert.

olivia: Noted — will send heartbeat every 5m to this thread with `kv.prefix.hitrate` numbers.
